title: Pocket Monsters
justification: AniDB special S2 "A Sneak Peek at Pokemon!" and S3 "Fall Special" (1997-10-07) had no row and fell on TVDB season 0 episode 2 "Pokemon: The Movie 2000 - The Power of One" and episode 3 "Pokemon 3: The Movie - Spell of the Unown", which belong to the film nodes. TVDB season 0 (82 episodes: films, Pikachu shorts, TV specials) has neither a sneak peek nor a fall special, so both are unmapped. S1 "Slowking's Day" stays on season 0 episode 23 "Slowking's Day".
